_doc: Entity analysis bot orchestration — Ciridae-style profile depth at NFRI scale. Consumed by harness/agent_deploy.py --profiles, harness/profile_harness.py, and expand-layer skills. Writes to data/records.scored.json (sub-factors) and contract/entity_copy.json (synthesis). Never writes axis scores — scoring stays in harness/scoring.py.

ciridae_firm_profile: Per-axis rationale block explaining the table
Drill-down on click with full sub-scores
ciridae_company_profile: Named factor definitions with info icons
nfri_surpass: Same narrative depth PLUS register-backed deterministic ratings
Evidence tier + λ fusion on every sub-factor
Measured value callouts when register exists
In-force rules that re-price this entity's sub-factors
Downloadable provenance row in dataset CSV

register.model: Analyst memo at point of rating: who they are, what the bet is, how prepared they are, what the registers say, what we still don't know.
register.ratio: ≥70% entity-specific underwriting/grid fact; ≤30% index construct explanation.
register.sentence_mix: Lead with the entity's book or asset; one machinery sentence per sub-factor (register, filing, product name).
register.honesty_rule: If tier=assessed, say so in the rationale. Never imply measurement where only research exists.

content_layers.writes: Sub-factor definitions, weight tooltips — same for all entities

profile_blocks.deliver: 3–4 sentences: book posture, non-firm exposure shape, preparedness gap or strength, provisional caveat if assessed-heavy.
Two tables (E1–E5, P1–P5) with eff score, weight, tier badge — Ciridae durability/opportunity pattern mapped to NFRI axes.
One paragraph per axis: why exposure/prep landed where they did; cite strongest measured sub-factor.
grid_posture, risk_manifestation[], cover_stack (evidenced/inferred/absent/gaps), mining provenance — contract/entity_analysis.json
Full rationale (no char cap), measured_value line, sources, citation_ids — current sfBlock target.
Swarm interpretation: book shape vs carrier headline MoS; named linked assets at tails.
Chips from KG edges: Nimbus, DCLP, Parametrix, availability products.
2–3 cards: title, body, severity, sub_factors[], mining_gap, sources[] — contract/key_risks.json
Link strip: Full methodology → sub-factor anchor; fusion formula one-liner.
researched_by, last_checked, method, evidence tier breakdown.

bots.ask: For each of 10 sub-factors: rating anchor, 2–4 sentence rationale, ≥1 source URL, citation_ids from contract/citations.json.
bots.ban: Inventing GWP, SCR, or register values; scoring axes; vendor marketing as sole source.

bots.ask: Gate status, MW, connection type, curtailment exposure; map non_firm_intensity and trigger_gap from registers where possible.
bots.output: asset_link block + exposure sub-factors with measured tier when register read succeeds.
bots.ban: Firm gate without Gate-2 evidence; coordinates without DNO source.

bots.ask: Energy/power class share, stamp capacity context, parent group product spillover.
bots.output: book_concentration + product_fit rationales with Lloyd's / AM Best sources.
bots.ban: Treating syndicate as standalone without parent group context when parent exists.

bots.ask: Cat aggregation exposure to UK power/DC cedants; capital strength mapping.
bots.output: capital_reinsurance + aggregation_correlation with rating agency citations.

bots.ask: Given scored record + sub-factor rationales, write entity-specific thesis without repeating sub-factor text verbatim.
bots.ban: Generic index manifesto; 'leading insurer' filler; hiding provisional status.

bots.ask: Given linked L3 assets + swarm stats, explain divergence between carrier MoS and portfolio distribution.
bots.ban: Inventing placement edges not in entity_links or segment tags.

bots.ask: Which KG product nodes connect to this entity via edges in contract/knowledge/graph.json?
bots.ban: Products not in KG; speculative binder relationships.

bots.role: Methodology gloss at point of use
bots.ask: One sentence per sub-factor definition from rubric.json; fusion one-liner for profile footer.
bots.ban: Changing weights or λ; LLM axis scores.

bots.ask: Is every rating ≥1 sourced? Are tiers correctly labeled? measured_value present when tier=measured?
bots.output: Pass/fail per entity; patches to fix missing sources.

bots.ask: Grid posture from registers; how loss manifests; cover stack with evidenced/inferred/absent tiers. Template: nscale-loughton-essex.
bots.ban: Synthetic policy limits; naming lead insurer without source.

bots.role: Key risks callouts — Ciridae-style profile cards
bots.ask: Given scored record + entity_analysis + sub-factor tiers, write 2–3 distinct key_risks cards. Name mechanisms, absent triggers, mining pass to close. Reference contract/key_risks_framework.json.
bots.ban: Generic index boilerplate; repeating executive_summary; hiding assessed tier.

workflow: 3. Pass A: fan out L1 carrier_researcher batches (10 entities/pass)
4. Pass B: fan out L3 asset_researcher batches
5. Pass C: profile_editor on all entities with scores (parallel by layer)
6. Pass D: portfolio_analyst on L1 with linked assets

parallel_passes.entities: thin measured share L4 + L1 + MGAs

essay_moves: Scores from code, stories from bots — never invert
Every sub-factor card answers: what · how rated · what register · what's missing
Executive summary is entity thesis, not index abstract
Portfolio swarm gets a narrative, not only SVG
Methodology follows the eye — link from each tier badge to methodology.html anchor
Surpass Ciridae: show fusion math and evidence tier on every line item
exit_checks: executive_summary present for all L1 entities
